info.title: Campus Resource Platform — implemented D APIs
info.description: Static contract for the implemented D identity, spaces, settings, check-in codes, audit and Phase 5 durable owner inbox. Public JWT and private opaque service credentials are separate trust domains. Success is {data,requestId}; errors are {code,message,requestId}; arrays have no invented page wrapper. D exposes 35 operations. M1 owns attendance and reminder scheduling; inbox acceptance is not email delivery or proof of reading. Schema and public contracts remain draft for human review. Runtime actuator APIs are separate in docs/api/runtime.md.

post.description: Only anonymous business operation. Returns an HS256 access JWT (local/default lifetime 15 minutes), Bearer type, UTC expiry and current actor. Invalid username, wrong password or disabled user all return the same AUTHENTICATION_FAILED 401. No refresh token or school SSO is implemented.

get.description: Read only: returns 404 CHECKIN_CODE_NOT_FOUND until today’s code has been created. Missing or disabled room returns 404. No generation or rotation occurs. Date is computed from injected Clock and business zone (local Asia/Shanghai). Eight cryptographically random characters exclude I, O, 0, 1. No global uniqueness, same-day rotation, QR payload or actual check-in is promised.

post.description: Ensure operation returns 200 for both initial generation and an existing code. The room/date primary key and room row lock make concurrent calls converge on one daily code and one creation audit event. A disabled room cannot generate a code. Date is computed from injected Clock and business zone (local Asia/Shanghai). Eight cryptographically random characters exclude I, O, 0, 1. No global uniqueness, same-day rotation, QR payload or actual check-in is promised.

post.summary: Verify a room’s current code without exposing it
post.description: Only reservation-service identity may call. Unknown/disabled room, absent current-date code or a well-formed mismatch returns 200 with valid:false. Malformed code/ID returns 400. Uses business date at request time and constant-time code comparison. It has no side effects and does not verify a reservation, user ownership or attendance; M1 Phase 5 performs those attendance checks using this real HTTP result.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user’s durable inbox
get.description: Requires reservation:view:self. Only rows for the current authenticated user; SYSTEM_ADMIN has no cross-user override. Ordered by id descending with limit 1–100 (default 50), offset≥0. Data is an array, including retained expired-window history. It proves D persistence, not reading, push, SMS or email delivery.

post.summary: Accept an idempotent M1 reminder into the durable owner inbox
post.description: Only reservation-service opaque identity may call. New source (M1,sourceRefId) persists one item and one system audit in the same D transaction and returns 201. Exact duplicate payload, comparing timestamps as Instants, returns 200 with the original item and no duplicate audit, including after the original recipient is disabled. A source reused with different recipient/reservation/room/time/kind returns 409 NOTIFICATION_SOURCE_CONFLICT. New nonexistent/disabled recipient returns 422 NOTIFICATION_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE; invalid due/expiry arithmetic returns 422 NOTIFICATION_INVALID_WINDOW. Malformed/unknown fields return 400. M1 is responsible for scheduling, current reservation eligibility and its dispatch window; D does not call M1 or read its tables. Acceptance means durable inbox storage, not recipient read or external-channel delivery.

UserBearer.description: HS256 access JWT from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Local/default expiry 15 minutes; issuer https://campus-resource.local/platform, audience campus-web. Roles/permissions and authVersion are checked against PostgreSQL each request. No refresh token.

InternalCaller.description: Private backend-network opaque credential. Three distinct secrets of at least 32 UTF-8 bytes identify reservation-service, classroom-service or maintenance-service. User JWTs are rejected. Only reservation-service may verify a check-in code or submit a notification.

EnabledOnly.name: enabledOnly
EnabledOnly.description: When true, include only enabled seats in an enabled room. False preserves the original metadata contract, including disabled seats.

HasPowerOutlet.name: hasPowerOutlet
HasPowerOutlet.description: When supplied, return seats whose actual power-outlet flag equals the requested value. Applied before pagination.

SeatId.name: seatId
SeatId.description: Optional exact seat ID within the requested room, applied before pagination.

Error.description: Errors are flat objects; they do not contain data. Use code, not localized message text, for program logic.

accessToken.description: Sensitive HS256 JWT. Never log it or persist it in an URL.

newPassword.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, non-blank. Character count is not the UTF-8 byte count.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, non-blank. Character count is not the UTF-8 byte count.

roleCodes.description: Known role codes. An empty array creates a user without roles; room scopes are never implicit.

UpdateUser.description: At least one non-null field is required; empty or whitespace displayName is 422. Null/absent fields are unchanged.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, non-blank. Character count is not the UTF-8 byte count.

roleCodes.description: Known role codes. An empty array removes all roles; last enabled SYSTEM_ADMIN is protected.

ReplaceRoomScopes.description: Replaces the complete scope, not an additive patch. Target must have ROOM_ADMIN; every room must exist.

ReplacePermissions.description: Replaces all permissions of the role. SYSTEM_ADMIN mapping is fixed; no role or permission creation API exists.

RoomPatch.description: At least one non-null field is required. buildingId, code or type require SYSTEM_ADMIN even when unchanged. Scoped ROOM_ADMIN can supply only name and enabled.

SeatPatch.description: At least one non-null field is required. Source room scope is checked. Supplying roomId requires SYSTEM_ADMIN and an existing target room.

maxReservationHours.description: Default reference value is 4 hours. Phase 3 stores this value; reservation enforcement belongs to M1.

date.description: Current business date in CAMPUS_BUSINESS_ZONE; local Compose uses Asia/Shanghai.

code.description: Sensitive room/day code. Only authorized room managers can read it; never log it.

CodeVerificationResult.description: No correct code is disclosed. True only for this enabled room and current business date; this is not a reservation check-in.

sourceRefId.description: Stable idempotency source; actual M1 sender uses reservation-reminder:<reminder ID>.

NotificationWrite.description: Trusted M1 payload only, with explicit-offset timestamps. CHECKIN_FIRST requires dueAt=startAt−15min and expiresAt=startAt+10min; CHECKIN_SECOND requires +10min/+15min. D checks this arithmetic, recipient availability for new sources and source identity; M1 owns reservation eligibility and dispatch expiry.

sourceRefId.description: Stable idempotency source; actual M1 sender uses reservation-reminder:<reminder ID>.

Notification.description: Persisted D inbox item. createdAt is the actual D acceptance time. No read/delivery boolean is invented; timestamps serialize as UTC Instants. Logical reservation/room IDs are supplied by authenticated M1, with no cross-schema SQL.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed JSON, DTO/query validation or password byte length; EMPTY_PATCH for an empty space patch.
